title: Born for the Task: Rethinking Quantum Chemistry with Foresighted Agentic Computing
abstract: arXiv:2611.22897v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Quantum chemistry relies on general-purpose software, whose generality leaves many large-scale calculations beyond practical resource budgets. Coding agents make task-specific programs cheap to write, but not efficient ones easy to find: whether a computational strategy is accurate and fast enough becomes clear only after it actually runs at the target scale. We introduce BORN, a foresighted agentic computing framework that synthesizes high performance quantum chemistry programs on demand. BORN anticipates the behavior of each strategy before execution, extrapolating its error from representative small systems and predicting its runtime from the target-scale workload and measured hardware throughputs. Building on these predictions, BORN unfolds the preset schemes of existing packages into independently configurable algorithmic components, selects the fastest strategy within the error tolerance from the predicted accuracy-runtime Pareto f

translated_title: 为任务而生：以前瞻性智能体计算重新思考量子化学
translated_abstract: 量子化学依赖于通用软件，而其通用性导致许多大规模计算超出了实际可承受的资源预算。编码智能体使得编写面向特定任务的程序变得廉价，但要轻易找到高效的程序却并不容易：一个计算策略是否足够精确且快速，只有当它真正在目标规模下运行之后才能明确。我们提出了BORN，一个前瞻性智能体计算框架，可按需合成高性能量子化学程序。BORN在执行之前预判每种策略的行为：从具有代表性的小体系中外推其误差，并根据目标规模的工作负载与实测的硬件吞吐量预测其运行时间。基于这些预测，BORN将现有软件包的预设方案展开为可独立配置的算法组件，从预测的精度-运行时间帕累托前沿中选取误差容限内最快的策略……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: BORN是一个前瞻性智能体计算框架，通过在执行前预测各计算策略的精度与运行时间，将现有量子化学软件包的预设方案拆解为可配置组件，从而按需自动合成并选出误差容限内最快的高性能计算方案。
en_tdlr: BORN is a foresighted agentic computing framework that predicts each strategy's accuracy and runtime before execution, unfolding preset schemes of existing quantum chemistry packages into configurable components to on-demand synthesize the fastest high-performance program within the error tolerance.
